info.title: Rizqim API
info.description:
Rizqim backend API (`/api/v1`): Telegram Mini App, ega/menejer/kuryer ekranlari va to'lov webhooklari.

**Kirish:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Laravel Sanctum). Token `POST /v1/auth/telegram` orqali olinadi.

**Javob formati:** `{ "success": bool, "message": string, "data": ... }`. Xatolarda `success: false` va `message`;
validatsiya xatolari (422) `errors` maydonida keladi.

Spetsifikatsiya koddan yaratiladi: `cd backend && php artisan api-spec:export` (`packages/api-spec/openapi.json`).

get.description:
The orders the user may see: a customer's own, a courier's deliveries, the store's (owner) or the branch's
(manager), newest first, with the relations the apps show. Without `scope`: every order, unpaginated (kept for
app versions from before scopes). `scope=active`: the orders still in progress (at most 200; `meta.truncated`
says more exist). `scope=history`: finished orders (delivered, canceled, rejected, refunded), keyset-paginated:
send `meta.next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is null.
get.summary: List orders

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Omit for the full legacy list.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Only with `scope=history`: page size, 1-50 (larger values are capped at 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Only with `scope=history`: `meta.next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.description:
Prices, stock, the promo code and the delivery fee are checked on the server. `payment_url` is set for online
payment methods (Click, Payme): open it to pay; the order is cancelled when it stays unpaid. 400 with the reason
when the order cannot be placed (store closed, item unavailable, minimum not reached...).
403/422 when the order's status does not allow it or the courier is not the store's.
post.summary: Assign a courier to an order (owner, manager)

post.description:
The customer cancels their own order: only while it is new and unpaid (Order::isCancellableByCustomer), always
with the reason customer_request. Stock, promo use and the like come back as with any cancellation; a payment
arriving afterwards is refused by the payment webhooks. Returns the order as GET /orders lists it.
403/422 when the order's status or the user's role does not allow it.

Only the transitions the order's state machine allows; cancelling or rejecting needs a `reason`. Answers 200
with the unchanged order when it is already in that status; 403/422 when the transition is not allowed.
post.summary: Change an order's status (owner, manager, courier)

get.description:
`period` is today|week|month|year (the last 1/7/30/365 Asia/Tashkent calendar days) or custom with `from` and `to`
(YYYY-MM-DD, at most 93 days). Orders count by the day they were created; `revenue` is the total of the delivered
ones. All money is a number in UZS (two decimals at most). Cached for 60 s per store/branch and period.
get.summary:
Sales figures of the owner's store (a branch manager's branch) for a period, computed on the server:
revenue, order counts, average check, by payment method and order type, best sellers, couriers, average
kitchen and delivery times, and a daily series for charts
